statement: Each removed diagnostic file, and the owner that carries its effect today. Neither is claimed as redundant: both were rebuilt as scenarios that are started deliberately, produce a structured result and gate nothing.

tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.capability: How a publish and consume round trip, the thread pool, the process threads, the pending work items and the managed memory behave as bus lifecycles accumulate.
tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.wasMarked: [Explicit] inside the required RabbitMQ category, so the category counted it and never ran it.
whatCarriedOver: 240 start and stop cycles by default, sampled every 20 as before
the round trip is a real send into the bus endpoint and a handler that receives it, not a send that was merely accepted
the same five resource readings per sample
whatChanged: it is a program that is started deliberately rather than a test the category has to skip
the result is one JSON object instead of semicolon separated console lines
it refuses to start without the run-scoped broker of a run instead of addressing whatever is on localhost
tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.notEquivalentTo: The latency benchmark in the benchmark console, which never restarts a bus and therefore cannot observe accumulation across lifecycles.

tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.capability: A hundred thousand publishes in flight at once against one endpoint with a bounded consumer concurrency, measured to the last consumed message.
tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.wasMarked: [Explicit] inside the required RabbitMQ category, so the category counted it and never ran it.
whatCarriedOver: 100000 messages, concurrency limit 32, prefetch 10000, publisher confirmation off
an auto delete, non durable endpoint
completion of every message is awaited and reported, not only the publish
whatChanged: the queue name is run-scoped instead of the fixed input_queue_express, so two runs cannot meet
the result is one JSON object with the three durations and two rates instead of three console lines
the completion limit is a parameter rather than a fixture timeout
tests/Transports/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Rabb.notEquivalentTo: The throughput benchmark, which measures a steady rate rather than the behaviour of a single burst that is larger than the prefetch window.

provenRun.busLifecycle: 6 cycles sampled every 2, inside the pinned fixture through the canonical runner, exit code 0
provenRun.publishLoad: 3000 messages, concurrency 32, prefetch 1000, all 3000 consumed, exit code 0
provenRun.note: Run at a small scale to prove the scenarios work end to end. Their defaults remain the ones the removed files used.
